title: Agent chat correctness fixes: wire callbacks in PROD (critical) + abort/error precedence + orphaned tool-result + hardening
description: Audit of the new agent-chat feature found a production ship-blocker plus correctness gaps. Fix all: (1) CRITICAL — Shell.tsx (~2920-2927) only calls setAgentCallbacks() when isTestEnv (DEV / VITE_FLASH_TEST), but AgentChatPanel renders unconditionally (~3767). In production the callbacks are never wired, so every tool call fails via dispatchAgentCommand->requireCallbacks() 'agent callbacks not wired'. The in-browser chat is a real user feature (docs/32-agent-chat.md) and the MCP bridge also needs callbacks — so setAgentCallbacks must be wired whenever the app runs, not just in test env. VERIFY why it was gated (likely the MCP test bridge) and make the chat work in a normal prod build: ensure callbacks are set in all environments (keep any test-only bridge bits test-gated, but the callbacks themselves must be live). Confirm a tool call works in a non-test build path. (2) MEDIUM — agentLoop.ts reduceAgentEvent: the 'abort' case (~304) and 'error' case (~308) unconditionally overwrite status, so an 'abort' part can clobber a prior 'error' (and vice versa). Gate terminal transitions like the 'finish' case does (only transition from 'running'; define precedence so a real error isn't lost). Add tests for error-then-abort and abort-then-error. (3) MEDIUM — agentLoop.ts patchTool (~362-370): a tool-result with an unknown/orphaned toolCallId is silently dropped, leaving the chip stuck 'running' forever. Add a defensive path (warn + ideally surface) and a test for tool-result with unknown toolCallId. (4) LOW hardening — trim the OpenRouter key inside createDashOpenRouter/getModel (openrouterClient.ts) so call sites needn't; make response.messages append defensive (AgentChatPanel ~234-237/507: guard undefined). Do NOT log the API key anywhere. VERIFY: build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); the existing agent-chat e2e oracle still passes; add the new reducer tests. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: Shell.tsx (callbacks wiring), agentchat/agentLoop.ts, AgentChatPanel.tsx, openrouterClient.ts (+ tests).
